Final for Publication

File Number: 23076-T1

17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Substitute Narrative & Plans — 2954 West Roosevelt Road, Chicago, IL
Proposed Zoning: | C3-1 Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District
Lot Area: Approximately 13,671 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to permit a new four (4) pump
gas station (8 fueling positions total) and a one-story accessory retail
convenience store building at the subject property. The proposed retail
convenience store will measure approximately 25 ft.-8 in. in height
(measured to top of parapet) and contain 2,398 sq. ft. of floor area. The
subject property is a Transit Served Location (“TSL”) and will be supported
by seven (7) off-street parking spaces. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D
optional Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-
13-1101-T of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to
allow a gas station on a lot that is less than 20,000 sq. ft., but greater than
10,000 sq. ft. and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as allowed by
the Chicago Zoning code, for the attached plans.

(A) | The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 2,398 square feet (0.18 FAR)

() The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed

(C) The amount of off-street parking: 7 parking spaces

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 108 feet-4 inches
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 16 feet-2 inches
West Side: 6 inches
c. Rear Setback: 10 inches

() Building Height: 25 feet-8 inches (measured to top of parapet)
